## File to Modify

## Test Function to Add (before the "Run all tests" section at line ~194)

```bash
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Test 10: Part B contains inference-signal scan subsection
# (1175-497a: inference-signal scan in Part B with trigger words and MUST-execute)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
test_pipeline_part_b_inference_signal_scan() {
  echo ""
  echo "=== test_pipeline_part_b_inference_signal_scan ==="

  if [ ! -f "$PIPELINE_MD" ]; then
    fail "Shared pipeline file missing — cannot check for Part B inference-signal scan"
    return
  fi

  # Assert 1: inference-signal scan heading present in Part B
  if grep -q "Inference-Signal Scan" "$PIPELINE_MD"; then
    pass "Part B contains 'Inference-Signal Scan' section"
  else
    fail "Part B missing 'Inference-Signal Scan' section (grep: 'Inference-Signal Scan')"
  fi

  # Assert 2: hedging trigger words documented
  if grep -q "assume\|assumed\|presumably\|should be" "$PIPELINE_MD"; then
    pass "Inference-signal scan documents hedging trigger words (assume/assumed/presumably/should be)"
  else
    fail "Inference-signal scan missing hedging trigger words"
  fi

  # Assert 3: confident assertion trigger words documented
  if grep -qE "loaded from|provided by|is fetched from|pulled from" "$PIPELINE_MD"; then
    pass "Inference-signal scan documents confident assertion trigger words (loaded from / provided by / is fetched from)"
  else
    fail "Inference-signal scan missing confident assertion trigger words (loaded from / provided by / is fetched from)"
  fi

  # Assert 4: MUST-execute directive present
  if grep -q "MUST" "$PIPELINE_MD" && grep -q "Read\|Grep" "$PIPELINE_MD"; then
    pass "Inference-signal scan contains MUST-execute Read/Grep directive"
  else
    fail "Inference-signal scan missing MUST-execute Read/Grep directive"
  fi

  # Assert 5: 5-second timeout documented
  if grep -qE "5.second|5-second|timeout.*5|5.*timeout" "$PIPELINE_MD"; then
    pass "Inference-signal scan documents 5-second timeout"
  else
    fail "Inference-signal scan missing 5-second timeout documentation"
  fi

  # Assert 6: treat-as-not-verifiable-and-fire fallback
  if grep -qE "not-verifiable|not verifiable|treat as not" "$PIPELINE_MD"; then
    pass "Inference-signal scan documents treat-as-not-verifiable-and-fire fallback"
  else
    fail "Inference-signal scan missing treat-as-not-verifiable-and-fire fallback phrase"
  fi

  # Assert 7: prohibition on reasoning in lieu of tool call
  if grep -qiE "reasoning.*cached|cached.*context.*prohibited|reasoning.*lieu.*tool|prohibited.*as a substitute" "$PIPELINE_MD"; then
    pass "Inference-signal scan explicitly prohibits reasoning from cached context as substitute"
  else
    fail "Inference-signal scan missing explicit prohibition on reasoning-in-lieu-of-tool-call"
  fi
}
```

Then add `test_pipeline_part_b_inference_signal_scan` to the "Run all tests" section (before the Results block).
